entities.summary: Sukhwinder Singh (b. 1971-07-18, Amritsar) was a visual artist or sculptor of the Contemporary era, characterized by technology, globalization, and rapid social change, active in Amritsar and India. Known in the fields of india, composers & musicians, asia.
